definitions.full: H3053. yehab [ יְהָב ] noun [masculine] lot (as that which is given ) — י עַל ׳הַשְׁלֵךְ יְהָֽבְךָ Psa 55:23 cast on ׳י thy lot (the care, anxiety, etc. which are thy portion; compare דרכך עַליֿ ׳גּוֺל 37:5 ). **compare יַהֲבַת ᵑ7 11:6 , יְהָבִית Eccl 5:10 .
